Package dev.px.core.render

Interface Texture

public interface Texture
An opaque handle to an image owned by the active Render2D backend.

Core never touches pixels. A backend returns whatever it needs (a GL texture id, a NanoVG image handle, a Skija image) wrapped in an implementation of this, and Core passes it straight back on draw.
